content.title: SKF 6206 Open Deep Groove Ball Bearing - 30mm Bore x 62mm OD x 16mm Width, Steel Cage
content.short_description: SKF 6206 open-type deep groove ball bearing with 30 mm bore, 62 mm outer diameter, and 16 mm width. Steel cage construction rated for 19.5 kN dynamic load and 11.2 kN static load.
content.long_description:
The SKF 6206 is an open deep groove ball bearing sized for a 30 mm bore, 62 mm outer diameter, and 16 mm width, fitting standard 6206-series mounting configurations. The open seal type leaves both sides of the bearing exposed, allowing for external lubrication access and use in applications where the operating environment permits.

Internal construction uses a steel cage to retain the ball complement and maintain spacing under load. The bearing carries a dynamic load rating (C) of 19.5 kN, which applies to rotating load conditions, and a static load rating (C0) of 11.2 kN for stationary or slow-oscillating load conditions.

This bearing is suited for general industrial rotating equipment applications where the 6206 envelope dimensions are specified, including motors, pumps, gearboxes, and other power transmission assemblies requiring a 30 mm shaft bearing. Confirm shaft and housing fit tolerances, lubrication regime, and sealing requirements against the open design before installation.
